subject: Compensation request: production latency spike affecting inference pipelines
messages:
From: Anna Voss <anna.voss@medmount.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@medmount.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Production latency spike: urgent compensation request

Hi Irene,

We experienced a significant latency regression on Feb 12 between ~11:45–15:10 PST that impacted our batch inference pipeline (all jobs hitting timeouts or falling back to an older model). P95 latency jumped from ~20ms to ~900ms; several customer-facing features degraded. Our SRE team has attached a short timeline and error aggregates.

This incident caused failed jobs and an estimated revenue impact for the day. Given the severity, we need confirmation of (1) a formal incident report, (2) calculation of service credits per your SLA, and (3) a short-term trial extension while we validate remediation changes.

Please escalate — we need a response by EOD Pacific.

Thanks,
Anna Voss
Head of Platform, MedMount Health
[Attachment: medmount_incident_timeline.txt]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Voss <anna.voss@medmount.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike: urgent compensation request

Hi Anna —

I'm very sorry about the disruption. Thank you for the timeline — that's helpful. We're already treating this as a Sev2 and our infra team has the traces. I will coordinate an internal review and get you an initial incident write-up and a proposed credit calculation by EOD tomorrow.

Quick asks so we size the right remediation: can you confirm the approximate committed spend for Feb and any specific invoice you want us to reference for credit calculation? If you prefer, we can offer an interim trial extension while we finalize numbers.

I'll loop in finance and the account lead.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Production latency spike: MedMount compensation request

Team — forwarding MedMount's escalation. Incident window ~3.5 hours, P95 went from ~20ms to ~900ms, causing job timeouts and fallback behavior. Customer is asking for incident report + SLA credit calc + a short trial extension while they validate remediation.

My recommendation (based on the impact and relationship):
- One-time service credit equal to 40% of Feb committed spend (they're on a committed Dedicated plan).
- 45-day trial extension on top of their current contract window as a gesture to cover validation/QA time.

Rationale: outage lasted multiple hours during business hours, and several customer-facing features were impacted; this is more than a brief blip but not a full >=72hr outage. 40% mirrors past precedence while keeping runway for renewal talks.

Attachments: sla_credit_calculation.xlsx (draft), incident_report.pdf (initial extract).

Please confirm approval or propose changes. If approved, I'll send the formal offer and DocuSign amendment.

Thanks,
Irene
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike: MedMount compensation request

Irene — thanks for the clear write-up. I support a credit offer and a time-based extension, but propose a small tweak:
- Offer one-time credit equal to 35–40% of Feb committed spend (leaning to 40% if Finance signs off).
- Extend contract by 60 days (covers validation + any slow approvals on their side).

I'll loop in Finance/accounting for the final number and request they route the credit allocation to the correct GL code. Sean — can your team confirm that the root cause remediation ETA is acceptable for the extended validation window?

If Finance approves, please proceed with DocuSign amendment and include the incident report as a supporting exhibit.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike: MedMount compensation request

Confirmed — Finance approves a one-time credit equal to 40% of their Feb committed spend and a 60-day contract extension. Please use accounting code CR-2027-067 and attach the SLA calculation workbook as backup. I'll prepare a short Docusign amendment template (AMEND-467) we can reuse for similar cases.

Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Voss <anna.voss@medmount.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Feb 2027 09:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Resolution & remedial offer for Feb 12 latency incident

Hi Anna —

Thank you for your patience while we investigated. Summary and remedial offer below:

What happened (short): around 11:45–15:10 PST on Feb 12 our autoscaling path experienced a regression in KV cache invalidation that increased host-side latency under a specific workload pattern. Our engineers have pushed a fix and validated recovery across your observed traffic patterns. Full timeline and technical details are attached.

What we are offering:
- One-time service credit equal to 40% of your Feb committed monthly spend (applied to your next invoice).
- A 60-day contract extension (applies immediately upon DocuSign amendment execution).
- A complimentary 30-day technical review with our infra SREs to help validate your post-fix rollout (optional).

Attachments: incident_report.pdf, sla_credit_calculation.xlsx, docusign_amendment_467.pdf (amendment + signature fields).

Next steps:
1) Please review the incident report and credit calculation.
2) Sign the attached amendment (DocuSign link in the PDF) to finalize the extension and credit application.
3) If you'd like the SRE review, reply with 2–3 windows that work for your team and we'll schedule.

Again, apologies for the disruption — we appreciate your partnership and will follow up with a postmortem meeting invite.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
